title: Chord recognition acceptance bar (ROADMAP section 10, Phase I)

rows.label: Duration CSR (triad-reduced)
rows.guards: the product's headline chord correctness: the simple view a player reads

rows.label: Duration CSR
rows.guards: the phase-2 vocabulary paying for itself, since it is scored on all 25 labels
rows.note: The recorded figure is 0.6312 (docs/ENGINE_COMPARISON.md section 8, 2026-10-27). Lower than the triad-reduced bar on purpose: the two views are graded separately.

rows.label: Segment overlap (MIREX mean)
rows.guards: how long each chord is held once it is right

rows.label: Change F1
rows.guards: where the changes land in time, precision and recall together

rows.label: Boundary error ref -> hyp (s)
rows.guards: the frame the listener sees when a chord changes
rows.note: Each take's figure is itself a median (metrics/segmentation.py:timing_error), so the aggregate has to say which statistic over the 180 takes it means: this row is the mean of those per-take medians. ROADMAP section 10 wrote 'median boundary error' and docs/ENGINE_COMPARISON.md section 8 prints a boundary column without naming its statistic, so 0.158 s cannot be graded against this row until a run publishes the statistic -- which is why the committed accuracy vector leaves the metric out rather than pinning the wrong one.

ungraded.name: vocabulary_no_loss
ungraded.rule: triad-reduced CSR after a vocabulary change: no loss greater than 0.005 between the raw and the triad-reduced view
ungraded.why: It compares two runs of a configuration that does not exist yet: the phase-1 engine raises InputError on vocabulary_phase greater than 1, so there is nothing to grade until the vocabulary work (audit P6) lands. It is a rule about a change, not a level, so no single record can satisfy it.
ungraded.where: ROADMAP section 10, the same table; graded by running scripts/chord_benchmark.py twice, before and after the change, and comparing the csr_triads means with benchmark/regression.py.

ungraded.name: confidence_ece
ungraded.rule: held-out expected calibration error of the per-chord confidence: <= 0.05
ungraded.why: ECE is a calibration statistic, not a chord accuracy metric. The harness computes it in evaluation/confidence.py and accuracy vectors do not carry it, so this check reports it as ungraded instead of pretending to judge it. Confidence is reported alongside accuracy and never instead of it.
ungraded.value_note: 0.0363 on the held-out split, 2026-10-27 -- under the target, but met on the strength of that document section rather than of this check.

ungraded.name: second_corpus_triad_csr
ungraded.rule: a second corpus, triad-reduced CSR: reported, with the bar set when the corpus is chosen
ungraded.why: One corpus, one instrument and one annotation convention cannot evidence generalisation, and no second licence-clean corpus with real audio exists yet (task A2). A target invented before the corpus is chosen would be a guess.
ungraded.where: ROADMAP section 10 task A2, docs/DATASET.md and docs/LICENSE_AUDIT.md.

notes: Phase I is complete only when every required row above is met by a run recorded with its environment and date, the error decomposition (task A1) is on file with no unowned dominant class, and the second-corpus row carries a real number instead of an absence. No row may be satisfied by a confidence score. The 'now' figures this bar was proposed against are the 2026-10-27 measurement in docs/ENGINE_COMPARISON.md section 8.
